title: Skyworth SWTV-22AE-FHD (codename umeda, MediaTek), Google TV / Android 14 (SDK 34),
header:
Skyworth SWTV-22AE-FHD (codename umeda, MediaTek), Google TV / Android 14 (SDK 34),
firmware UKNV.260211.001.
Live TV app: com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter (set it as live_tv_package and hide it in launcher config.xml).
Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (pass it to restore.sh and build-and-install.sh:
STOCK_LAUNCHER=com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx launcher/build-and-install.sh).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/skyworth-swtv-22ae-fhd/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/skyworth-swtv-22ae-fhd/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Keep (TV needs them):
com.smartdevice.global.service (handles SkwGlobalKeyReceiver, OneKeyMenuDialog, remote keys)
com.skyworth.backligthadjust (backlight control)
com.smartdevice.bleconnectservice (SkyAutoPair bluetooth remote pairing)
com.mediatek.* (LiveTV, tuners, video player services)
com.google.android.katniss (Google Assistant - kept per user choice)
com.google.android.apps.mediashell (Chromecast built-in - kept per user choice)
com.google.android.inputmethod.latin (Gboard on-screen keyboard)

Google TV setup wizard
sections.note: RecoveryActivity claims Home with priority 1. Must be disabled to free Home and prevent crash loops on Google TV 14! Trade-off: disabling setupwraith gives Home back but costs casting (Chromecast built-in may stop working); re-enable it if you need casting.
